gates.pass: All required reference planes exist, are hash-bound, scaled, and provenance-labeled
Mean overlay error ≤1.5% and local error ≤3.0% outside documented occlusion zones
Mean overlay error ≤1.5% and local error ≤3.0% against dimensioned top reference
Zero non-manifold edges, zero zero-area faces, no unplanned highlight-path poles above valence five
Closed alignment ≤8 mm, glazing 6–12 mm, open aperture ≥0.72 x 0.78 m, sweep collision count zero
At least 77 of 81 central rays unobstructed with rear canopy fully open
Separate shell/lip/shutters/radial face/hub/blades, no intersections, continuous highlights
Context camera and G2-like highlight continuity pass with no oval overlap or self-intersection
Required families, UV/bake manifest and material-graze proof pass
All eleven fixed views meet screen fraction, margins and target visibility; no crop/reframe
Explicit reference fidelity, silhouette, surface, canopy, cowling, root, material and sightline approval
Separately authorized only after all Blender gates pass
